name: Classifier-free guidance (linear)
plain: The default mixing rule every guidance scale in ComfyUI goes through. The model is run on the positive and the negative conditioning, and the result is pushed along their difference by the cfg number. At cfg 1 the negative pass is skipped unless a sampler or hook disables that shortcut, so the negative prediction is all zeros. A custom cfg function replaces the line, and post-CFG functions run afterwards on its result.
math:
x̂_cfg = x̂_u + s·(x̂_c − x̂_u)
x̂_c, x̂_u = cond and uncond denoised (x0) predictions, s = cond_scale.
If model_options has sampler_cfg_function f: x̂_cfg = x − f({cond: x − x̂_c, uncond: x − x̂_u, ...}), so f works in x − x̂ space.
Then for each post-CFG function g in order: x̂_cfg ← g({denoised: x̂_cfg, cond_denoised, uncond_denoised, ...}).
label: from code

audit.note: Plain says the model is run on both conditionings, which is false at cfg≈1: sampling_function drops uncond unless disable_cfg1_optimization is set (ComfyUI/comfy/samplers.py:610-613). x̂_u is then an all-zero tensor, and hooks receive that zero tensor as uncond_denoised. The line still gives x̂_c at s=1.
